messages:
marcos: kicking off arn1 (Nordic edge) capacity gate. small cluster, 4xA10g pools. goal: onboard to prod routing tomorrow. quick checklist?
anya: awesome — I ran the infra plan this morning, VPC/subnet created, IGW + NATs done. still waiting on provider GPU quota increase.
devon: quota is approved but provider needs 2hr window to attach GPUs. ETA ~18:30 UTC.
sre-lead: reminder — this node pool uses our new nvlink-enabled AMI, double-check driver + dcgm. failing that we fallback to non-nvlink flavor.
marcos: noted. steps I want in the smoke run: health endpoints, per-GPU NVML check, k8s node readiness, small perf load (100 concurrent short requests), and 99p latency under 450ms.
anya: adding network checks: MTU verification, cross-zone latency to sfo, and control-plane health (api-server p95 < 200ms).
devon: I pasted quick commands:

marcos: ```
# node checks
kubectl get nodes -o wide
kubectl describe node arn1-gpu-0
ssh ubuntu@arn1-gpu-0 'nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,memory.total,temperature.gpu --format=csv'
# service smoke
curl -sS https://arn1-api.internal/health | jq .
# small load
hey -n 1000 -c 100 https://arn1-api.internal/generate?model=rwx-small
```
sre-lead: add DCGM check: `sudo systemctl status nvidia-dcgm` and `dcgmi dmon -e` to confirm metrics.
anya: provider reported one node had NIC firmware mismatch yesterday. make sure kernel logs don't show large IOMMU warnings: `dmesg | grep -i iommu`
marcos: good call. I'll run those after nodes are up.
oncall-bot: deploy-job #4872 queued -> arn1-gpu-pool @ marcos
marcos: deploying runtime image v2.3.1 to arn1 now. will post results.
(devon joined the thread)
devon: runtime deployed, kube readiness: 4/4 nodes Ready.
anya: nvidia-smi shows all GPUs present, but one reports ECC errors count > 0. looks like transient; clearing ECC counters and re-checking.
marcos: ECC cleared, re-check after 10 mins.
sre-lead: smoke perf run: 1000 requests, concurrency 50 -> p50 120ms, p95 420ms, p99 680ms. p99 above gate.
anya: p99 spike correlated with one pod restarting (OOM). logs show `kv-cache` initialization spike; probably batch size config.
devon: scaled replicas from 10 -> 14, enabled warm-start cache. rerunning.
marcos: rerun perf after scale. also verifying autoscaler thresholds: target CPU 60, max 20 nodes.
marcos: second run: p99 400ms, under 450ms. marking latency gate pass.
sre-lead: service-level gates summary:
- node readiness: PASS
- GPU driver/DCGM: PASS
- network MTU/cross-zone latency: PASS (avg 18ms to sfo)
- health endpoint: PASS
- perf p99 latency: PASS
- stability (no restarts 15m): WARNING -> initial OOM restart observed, resolved by scaling

anya: cost note: using on-demand A10g for now. if sustained load looks stable we should propose reserved commit or spot mix. estimate $X/day at baseline — I'll draft numbers in pricing doc.
devon: also flag: provider limits ephemeral IPs per VPC ~250, our overlay requires ~60. safe for now but track as we scale.
marcos: handoff checklist for oncall: environment tag arn1, runbook link https://rwd.internal/runbooks/arn1-bringup, alerting set (p99 latency, GPU ECC > 5, node NotReady).
marcos: handing off to oncall for overnight validation — leave in monitoring for 12h, if stable we'll flip prod routing tomorrow 12:00 UTC. @sre-lead can you ack?
sre-lead: acked. I'll own the overnight watch & escalate if any NIC/firmware regressions pop up.
anya: I'll follow up with cost estimates and quota ticket to expand pool if we decide to scale.
devon: leaving a small note: add migration plan for models pinned to older kernels — we saw one model crash on 5.15 -> 6.1. need compatibility matrix in the runbook.
oncall-bot: reminder set for 12h watch at 2026-03-19T06:30:00Z
marcos: thanks team. will post a short handoff summary in the runbook after the overnight window. :)
